name: studio-scope-deploy
description: Multi-app deployment for Studio Scope dashboards

scripts.install:all: cd studio-scope && npm install && cd ../studio-scope-generic && npm install
scripts.build: cd studio-scope && npm run build && cd ../studio-scope-generic && npm run build && mkdir -p dist && cp -r studio-scope/dist dist/studio-scope && cp -r studio-scope-generic/dist dist/studio-scope-generic && cp public/index.html dist/index.html && cp public/serve.json dist/serve.json
scripts.postinstall: cd studio-scope && npm install && cd ../studio-scope-generic && npm install
